scientific_integrity: Exact rational enumeration plus analytic projection/KKT identity; separate optional quadratic-programming corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the canonical [15,4,8] simplex code and 32768 Boolean cube corners. Neither a family-wide theorem nor a full continuous-cube distance distribution. Historical priority remains provisional; no independently conducted scholarly review.
title: Thirteen exact Euclidean corner-distance shells of the binary \([15,4,8]\) simplex-code polytope
